title: Nice but There are Some Issues
text:
Nice but There are Some Issues. My flat screen television has been resting atop a television stand made using glass and with a wood finish for some time. The stand is okay, but it is rather low- lying and I decided that an upgrade was in store. This was enough to convince me to add the Rockpoint Plymouth 53 Inch Wood TV Stand Storage Console to my family room.

This television stand comes in a box, packed inside of another box, and requires quite a bit of assembly. Unpacking it creates quite a mess, as the Styrofoam bits scatter everywhere. When you look at the multiple bags of hardware needed to complete the assembly, you may contemplate not doing the work at all and hiring someone else to do the job.

It does take time to assemble this and it helps if you have someone to help you, so if you decide to take the plunge, get yourself an assistant. Once finished, the stand does look nice and since it is black, it blends with most any décor. I like that it even comes with a special pen that you can use to conceal scratches. This is a good thing to have and in fact, I had to use it right away because some of the pieces had scratches on them. The cabinet loses some points in this area.

This stand does, indeed, elevate my flat screen television about ten inches from its previous height, so it fulfills its purpose. Again, I’m not thrilled with the blemishes or the way the device was packed and the assembly instructions are not always easy to follow. So, overall, considering everything, this stand earns an average rating from me.
